scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.dev:frontend: set PORT=3000&& set BASE_PATH=/&& pnpm --filter @workspace/vibelink run dev
scripts.dev:api: set PORT=4000&& pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run start
scripts.dev:local: powershell.exe -NoLogo -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Start-Process pnpm -ArgumentList 'run','dev:api' -NoNewWindow; Start-Process pnpm -ArgumentList 'run','dev:frontend' -NoNewWindow; Wait-Process -Name pnpm"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
